engine_install: Install the existing backend-mcp extra in a Python 3.12+ engine environment. Explicitly add any required deployment-specific variables to env_passthrough; no credential belongs in this file.
notes: Executes the canonical whole-product MCP server unchanged, not the historical compile-only adapter. Native configuration and authorization govern its tools. Bridge --allow-writes is neither a filter nor an authority override for native mode. Protocol discovery does not establish physical correctness, provider competence, or remote deployment security.
